Compute E,F as perpendicular feet from I to AC,AB. K=2nd intersect of (A,E,F) with circumcircle; K′=reflection across EF; N=proj_D_on_EF. Circle through B,K tangent to BN gives T with BT=2·O′_x. Ratio R=CT·NB/(BT·NE). Enforce cyclic B,K,K′,N ⇒ one‑parameter equation in t; solve numerically → unique t_n. R_n alternates about 1; for even n, R_{2n}<1 and →1 as n→∞. Hence α=1=0+√1 ⇒ p=0,q=1 ⇒ ⌊p^{q^p}⌋=0 mod 99991. Pitfalls: use absolute lengths for BT,CT; ensure correct orientation for circle tangent; numeric root‑finding for t.
